0.text: Pstt! You there! Get over here before somebody sees!

1.text: You’re not from around here are you. Though, I suppose, neither am I… but my disguise far surpasses whatever it is you’re wearing…

2.text: Anyway, would I be right in assuming that you’re working for Boss Ngathu?

0.text: Ah! Fantastic! Then I can rid myself of this Ithecac shipment. I don’t belong here. I only agreed to bootleg for him because he threatened my family.

1.text: From the looks of your face, he’s done something similar to you too.

2.text: Damn crime lords - no one works for them willingly. I guess that’s how they like it - power trip or something…

0.text: Anyway, here’s the Ithecac shipment. Take it and go. Make sure you deliver it to the right bloke in Guild City, else Ngathu will string you up by your ankles.

1.text: ...Oh, and if you want my advice? Whatever business you have with that bastard, end it before you find yourself weighed down at the bottom of Loch Laroo.

2.text: One last thing, there have been attacks on our shipments as of late. Fiends trying to get a ride on the psychedelic wave. Keep an eye out for them.

3.text: I shouldn’t need to tell you what Ngathu will do to both of us  if you were to lose even a single drop...
